_format: hls-est math-function cost table (MEMOS decision #18; VITIS_NOTES.md N16). JSON so that hls-est (llvm/Support/JSON.h)
and the Python harness (stdlib json) read it without new dependencies; edit it by hand to add (function, type) pairs.
entries[]: one per (function, element type, argument form). Keys:
function, type ('float' | 'double' | 'half' | 'ap_fixed<W,I>' - W and I matter, other widths must be added),
spellings (source spellings that reach the same core), arguments ('any' | 'constant base' | 'constant exponent'),
core (Vitis module or IP of one instance, or inlined), core_kind (fp_operator | library_module | inline_cordic | inline),
bram_18k = BRAM_18K of ONE instance (the whole cost of a v1 kernel whose only memory is the core's),
dsp / ff / lut = the same kernel's totals, recorded only (Phase 6 on hold; FF/LUT vary a few % with context),
instancing = key into instancing_rules, tables = the core's ROMs (words x bits, storage, BRAM at one read per cycle),
cordic_loop_trip_count / bram_18k_if_cordic_loop_unrolled for inline_cordic, evidence (runs), variants (BRAM and
core-instance counts of the v1..v7 kernels of that pair, 'inlined' when no core module exists, ii = achieved II of
the first loop of mc_top or of its Pipeline sub-module; kernel variants are described in VITIS_NOTES.md N16),
corpus_designs (td=off ground-truth designs whose csynth tables contain the core).
A (function, type) pair that is not listed has an UNKNOWN cost: report it, do not assume 0.
All-constant calls are folded by Vitis (rule const_fold): they cost nothing whatever the entry says.
Generated by ~/hls-est-work/exp-src/mathcost/make_math_costs.py from the vitis_adhoc result JSONs; kernels

instancing_rules.per_concurrent_call: Library-module core: BRAM = bram_18k x instances. Outside pipelines one instance per call that can run concurrently: two independent calls -> 2 (v2), a data-dependent pair f(f(x)) -> 1 (v2d), a call site in a sequential loop -> 1 (v3n), k unrolled copies in a sequential loop -> k (v4n), one instance per non-inlined parent and per instance of that parent (v5, v5s; N14 R2/R3). Inside a pipelined loop: ceil(calls per iteration / achieved II) (v3 1/1, v3x2 2/1, v4 4/1, v4ii2 4/2 = 2, v4ii4 4/4 = 1, v3x3ii2 3/2, v3dep chain 2/1, v7imp automatic pipeline of an imperfect nest; corpus attn_breakdown softmax 32 exp calls at II 16 -> 2). A core with variable-trip internal loops (sin_or_cos_double) keeps the enclosing loops from being pipelined automatically (N3), so its calls stay sequential (v7auto_sin_f64: 1 instance). '#pragma HLS allocation function instances=<wrapper> limit=1' on a user wrapper with 'inline off' forces one instance (v6w); naming the hls:: function does nothing (v6) except std::sin(double) -> 'sin' (v6_sin_f64_std).
instancing_rules.inline_tables: The core's code and ROM tables are inlined into the caller (always for the 'inline' kind; for some library modules when the caller is pipelined: exp/log/pow ap_fixed and sin/cos float were inlined in every pipelined variant, pow_generic / sin_or_cos_double / generic_tanh stayed modules - trigger unconfirmed). The tables are then ordinary caller ROMs priced by the band formula with calls per cycle as read ports: <= 2 reads per cycle cost the single-read count (v3x2, v4ii2), 4 reads -> 2 x18 copies (v4: exp_32_16 16 instead of 4 x 5 = 20).
instancing_rules.cordic_loop: ap_fixed sin / cos / tanh: inlined CORDIC loop (hls_cordic_apfixed.h VITIS_LOOP_61_1 / VITIS_LOOP_743_1, cordic_loop_trip_count trips) reading a 128-word arctan / arctanh table (4 BRAM). The table exists iff the CORDIC loop stays a loop: called outside any pipelined loop (v1, v2, v3n, v4n, v5) or flattened as the innermost loop of an automatically pipelined nest (corpus rope: 'Successfully converted nested loops ... VITIS_LOOP_61_1', 2304 = 128 x 18 trips) -> 4 per instance; inside a pipelined loop (pragma, any II, variable trip count, or Vitis's automatic pipelining of the enclosing loop with [HLS 214-291] 'complete unroll implied by the pipeline pragma') the loop is unrolled and the table folds -> 0 (v3, v3ii2, v3ii4, v3var, v4; corpus gelu). Treat the call as an inner loop of cordic_loop_trip_count trips in the N3 pipeline / flatten decision. sin and cos of the same ap_fixed argument share one CORDIC (v2_sincos 4); separate sin / cos calls on different arguments are separate instances (v2 8).
instancing_rules.logic_only: No memory at all (abs): 0 BRAM in every context.
instancing_rules.operator: Floating-point IP operator (fexp, flog, fsqrt, dexp, dlog, dsqrt, hexp, hlog, hsqrt): 0 BRAM in the v1 kernels and in every corpus design that uses one (DGNN_Booster x2, Mask-Net, GP float, backprop, soda, normals). 'allocation operation' / bind_op / config_op name these operators (Vitis help output); their sharing was not measured (it cannot change BRAM).
instancing_rules.const_fold: Calls whose arguments are all constants are folded (v1c: hls::log((T)3), std::sin(1.0), hls::powf(10000.0f, -0.25f) -> no core, 0 BRAM). A constant base of pow removes the log stage (pow float 7 -> 1, double 30 -> 5; entries with arguments 'constant base'); a constant exponent does not.
